title: Bridge and Ledger
author: A. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Ansel Thackeray, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
